messages:
maria (People Ops): Heads up — new Gifts & Anti-Bribery policy goes live next Tue (2026-04-07). Need to coordinate: handbook update, manager attestations, and a 20-min microlearning that everyone must complete. Tracking sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-anti-bribery-tracker :eyes:
aj (Recruiting): Got it. Will we need a short clause for offer letters / contractor SOWs? cc @emma (People Ops)
jordan (Legal): Yes — short clause ready. I'll paste approved language in a sec. Applies to employees, contractors, vendors who interact with customers. Exemption process also included (manager + legal approval).
handbook-bot: Handbook v3.2 published: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/anti-bribery-gifts — changed sections: Gifts, Conflicts, Escalation.
emma (People Ops): Quick ops plan: 1) Publish policy in handbook (done by handbook-bot). 2) Add one-slide + 3 quiz questions microlearning (20 min). 3) Managers attest by team that everyone completed course by 2026-04-21. 4) Nightly export of completions to GCS.
kyle (Eng Manager): For attestation — can managers delegate to ICs or do we need manager signature? Also can we get a per-team CSV so I can follow up quickly?
maria (People Ops): Managers must attest (manager-level signoff). Delegation allowed only if acting manager covers team and cc's original manager. We'll provide a per-team CSV export. export path: gs://redwood-hr-exports/antibribery/antibribery-completions-<YYYYMMDD>.csv
aj (Recruiting): For offers: we'll append this sentence to the onboarding packet: "All hires must complete Redwood's Anti-Bribery & Gifts training within 30 days of start date." Is that ok?
jordan (Legal): That sentence is fine. For contractors on short engagements (<30 days) include: "Contractor is expected to acknowledge policy and the hiring manager will track completion where feasible."
emma (People Ops): Draft of manager attestation form (Google Form fields):
```
- manager_email
- team_name
- attestation_date
- total_headcount
- completed_count
- notes
```
We'll auto-populate team_name and headcount from the HRIS where possible.
kyle (Eng Manager): Perfect. Can we get weekly digest emails with non-completers listed? I can ping my leads.
maria (People Ops): Yes — we'll send weekly digests to managers + ops leads starting next Monday. Also nightly CSV for ops to pull.
jordan (Legal): One compliance note — gifts under $50 still need to be logged if from vendors we have contracts with. Please add example line in the handbook to avoid confusion.
emma (People Ops): Will add a "Examples" subsection. Also creating 3 short quiz items that specifically call out the <$50 vendor rule.
aj (Recruiting): Heads up — onboarding checklist item added. New hires will get access to microlearning on day 1.
maria (People Ops): Timeline recap: Thurs EOD (announce + calendar invites to all), Fri (manager attestation form live), Mon next week (training opens), 2026-04-21 (manager attestations due).
kyle (Eng Manager): Thx. Can you also put a note in the manager weekly update about how to handle questions?
emma (People Ops): Yup — will add FAQ + contact: hr-compliance@redwood.ai.
jordan (Legal): I'll sit in a 30-min Q&A for managers on Tue 10am PT.
maria (People Ops): Awesome — added to the rollout plan. Final action items: Jordan to paste final policy language in tracker, Emma to create microlearning + quiz, Aj to update offer/onboarding copy, Handbook-bot already published link, Ops to configure nightly CSV exports. :thumbsup:
handbook-bot: New handbook update annotated by maria (People Ops) — change log: gift thresholds clarified; exemptions flow added; examples section added.
maria (People Ops): I'll post a company-wide announcement on Thurs and ping team leads. If anyone sees blockers (lap time, access, form fields) — flag here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
